sermon.title: Is God’s Presence Enough? — February 6, 2022
sermon.speaker: Michael Silla
sermon.summary: God’s presence and power came on Pharaoh, Saul, Samson and Elijah, but to grow and know God we must obey His voice. To obey is better than sacrifice; Lazarus came out when Jesus spoke, and Jesus told Peter to feed His lambs.
